title: ideal-knowledge-base made, from linux-phone-oco/docs and text-as-data-template
done: Started with tad init (tad 0.7.0, made for it the same day: decision 2026-11-17-tad-init in tad-engine). The practices, the five generic queries and the records with --about, the standing tables between idealkb:begin and idealkb:end, the short entry, bin/follow.sh and bin/update-pins.sh. The research it rests on carried from docs, with its 17 sources; the reasons text-as-data-template held for a base - the backlog as a table, extracted from a working repository - carried in as decisions before the template retired. The generic queries were first run against docs' 4k rows: about audio-mic 14 KB, next --about modem 0.2 KB, row 0.8 KB.
considered: Generic queries that know a base's project field; a declaration tad includes from another file.
rejected: Both fit one base and not another: a base whose records span places keeps its records as its own, and a base whose standing tables are extended keeps tables.toml's part as its own.
